title: Azad Kashmir Announces Major Tourist Spot Upgrades
excerpt: The Azad Jammu and Kashmir government plans to renovate multiple guesthouses and tuck shops to improve local tourism facilities.
body_html:
The Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) government has revealed new plans to upgrade local tourism infrastructure. According to the announcement, the initiative will focus on the renovation of 26 guesthouses across tourist locations.

In addition to the guesthouses, the project includes plans to improve 32 tuck shops situated at these tourist spots. The updates aim to enhance the facilities available to visitors traveling to the region.
